title: Site Reliability Engineer II (Platform Engineer)
description:
**Job Description**

Our SRE team builds tools that support our engineers to work faster, with less friction, and agentic AI is central to how we do it. As a Platform Engineer for Developer Experience & Agentic AI, you'll build agentic solutions, integrate them into our internal developer platform, and take them from prototype to production. You'll own the full lifecycle and set the standard for how AI-native engineering works at SIXT.

**YOUR ROLE AT SIXT**

* You own and evolve our core developer tooling, including observability and CI/CD, so engineers can build, ship and run their products fast and securely
* You architect and operate agentic solutions that take on real work in developers' daily routines which include multiple steps, tool-using systems that reason and act
* You embed agents into the internal developer platform, including the CI/CD and observability workflows
* You scale it all across SIXT so it works reliably for 800+ engineers in different teams and technology stacks
* You work with developers to solve their real-world challenges in their day-to-day work

**YOUR SKILLS MATTER**

* **Education** You hold a B.Tech, B.E., or Master's Degree in Computer Science or a closely related discipline
* **Experience** You have 4-7 years of hands-on experience as a Platform Engineer or Site Reliability Engineer with recent experience working on agentic AI
* **Agentic AI** You have hands-on experience building and deploying agentic AI systems: multi-step agents with tool use, memory and autonomous decision-making, going well beyond chatbots
* **Cloud-Native Infrastructure** You bring solid experience with Kubernetes and cloud-native infrastructure (AWS preferred), and with running AI workloads reliably at scale
* **Observability** You have hands-on experience with observability tools
* **System Engineering** You demonstrate strong system engineering skills and experience building at scale

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* **Grow Further, Go Further** Advance your skills and unlock your potential with our Education Assistance Program
* **AI Excellence** With Claude by Anthropic and SIXTgpt, our own AI platform, you work with state-of-the-art AI tools from day one, with the freedom to try new technologies and use AI to work faster and smarter
* **Balance Your Career** Benefit from a hybrid work environment complemented by flexible working hours
* **Fuel Your Day** Great work deserves great fuel — enjoy meal benefits that keep you energised and ready to bring your A-game
* **Your Wellness Matters** We are committed to your well-being through comprehensive insurance, wellness programs, health checkups, and fitness benefits
* **Recognition That Counts** We create a culture of appreciation, rewarding your impact through referral incentives and loyalty perks as you grow with us
* **Growing Families, Growing Joy** As your family grows, we are here to celebrate with a special newborn gift for your little one

  
**Additional Information**

**About us:**

We are a globally leading mobility service provider with a revenue of €4.3 billion and around 9,000 employees worldwide. Our mobility platform ONE combines our products SIXT rent (car rental), SIXT share (car sharing), SIXT ride (taxi, ride, and chauffeur services), and SIXT+ (car subscription), giving our customers access to our fleet of 360,000 vehicles, the services of 4,000 cooperation partners, and around 5 million drivers worldwide. Together with our franchise partners, we are present in more than 100 countries at 2,000 rental stations. At SIXT, top-tier customer experience and outstanding customer service are our highest priorities. We believe in true entrepreneurship and long-term stability and align our corporate strategy with foresight. Get started with us and apply now!

title: AI Operations Engineering Technical Leader
description:
Meet the Team 
  
The Cisco AI Software& Platform Group incubates and delivers Generative AI based solutions to reinvent Cisco's existing Products and how customers interact with them. Our Group is also introducing new offerings that help customers roll out Generative AI at scale while doing so responsibly. Ultimately, we are doing so through internal platforms that unlock the benefits of this technology for Cisco teams and partners across our Security, Enterprise Networking, Collaboration and Splunk portfolios.
  
  
Your Impact 
  
Cisco is looking for a highly experienced and innovative DevOps Engineer to join
  
our global DevOps team. In this critical role, you will architect and build scalable, secure
  
cloud infrastructure and lead the adoption of best-in-class DevOps practices across the
  
organization. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless code
  
delivery, system reliability, and operational excellence for our SaaS platforms.
  
 
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Implement end-to-end CI/CD workflows in a large-scale, distributed environment—enabling both on-demand and scheduled builds and deployments with zero downtime.
* Scale microservice-based platforms across multiple geographic regions, with a focus on container orchestration (Kubernetes), cost optimization, and automated scaling solutions.
* Lead cross-functional DevOps projects from inception to completion defining success criteria, coordinating execution, and measuring outcomes against clear KPIs.
* Collaborate with engineering, QA, and product teams to streamline delivery pipelines and promote DevOps best practices throughout the development lifecycle.
* Advocate automation in every layer of the infrastructure stack using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles and tools such as Terraform, Helm, and GitOps frameworks.
* Continuously evaluate and adopt emerging DevOps tools and technologies to increase system resilience, reduce operational overhead, and enhance developer productivity.
* Integrate AI-assisted tooling, copilots, and AIOps into day-to-day DevOps, CI/CD workflows, infrastructure automation, testing, and incident response to enhance efficiency and system reliability.
* Participate in on-call rotation.
* Serve as a subject matter expert within the DevOps organization—promoting a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelors degree in Comp Science, Engineering (or related field /industry) + 8 years of DevOps experience, Masters + 5 years of related experience, or PhD + 3 years of related experience.
* Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines and automation tools.
* Strong proficiency in Kubernetes, Docker
* Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Solid scripting and automation skills (e.g., Python, Bash, Go).

**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Deep expertise in CI/CD tooling and practices, including hands-on experience with systems like Jenkins, Github, ArgoCD, or similar.
* Demonstrated success scaling containerized microservices across regions with cost and performance optimizations.
* Proven leadership in cross-functional engineering projects with measurable outcomes.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and mentoring skills.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Oracle Health Database Services is seeking a highly experienced, Site Reliability Engineer to lead database reliability engineering across mission-critical healthcare platforms.

This individual-contributor role combines Oracle Database expertise, cloud engineering, automation, AI-assisted operations, and technical project leadership. The successful candidate will deliver measurable improvements in reliability, scalability, performance, operational readiness, and customer experience across database platforms.

This role is ideal for an engineer who can think strategically, execute hands-on, influence technical direction, and help transform traditional database operations into proactive, automated, engineering-led reliability practices.

  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own and improve database availability, performance, capacity, security, backup and recovery, and operational readiness.
* Lead complex production incident triage, mitigation, root-cause analysis, and preventive actions to reduce repetitive incidents.
* Define and improve operational standards, including runbooks, readiness reviews, escalation paths, SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, and service-health reporting.
* Identify repetitive operational work and build automation to reduce manual toil and operational risk.
* Lead strategic reliability initiatives, including OCI migrations, Exadata modernization, Autonomous Database adoption, database performance remediation, capacity planning, and GoldenGate reliability improvements.
* Build or enhance API-driven automation, health checks, monitoring, capacity forecasting, and self-service engineering workflows.
* Apply AI-assisted engineering practices to improve incident response, knowledge discovery, runbook automation, health checks, capacity analysis, and operational reporting.
* Partner with Customer Success, Infrastructure, Application, Security, Cloud Operations, and Product Engineering teams to address cross-functional reliability risks.
* Lead technical design reviews, mentor engineers, and promote strong software engineering and SRE practices.
* Lead complex engineering initiatives independently, from architecture and planning through delivery and production readiness.

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field; equivalent practical experience will be considered.
* 5+ years of experience as an Oracle DBA, Database Reliability Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer, Production Engineer, Oracle GlodenGate or similar role supporting business-critical services.
* Experience with Git, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, and automation or orchestration tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins, or equivalent.
* Strong technical judgment, problem-solving ability, and stakeholder communication skills.
* Experience leading cross-functional projects involving dependencies, risks, milestones, and executive-ready status reporting.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including technical designs, runbooks, post-incident reviews, and operational updates.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with OCI, Exadata, Oracle Autonomous Database, Data Guard, GoldenGate, or large-scale cloud database services.
* Experience defining SLIs, SLOs, alerting standards, capacity models, reliability scorecards, and service-health metrics.
* Experience creating API-driven automation, internal tools, self-service workflows, or engineering platforms.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted operations, agent-based workflows, MCP/API integrations, retrieval-based knowledge systems, or data and metrics pipelines.
* Experience applying AI responsibly within security, data-access, and change-control requirements.
* Experience supporting healthcare, regulated environments, or customer-facing enterprise platforms

title: Oracle Lead Database SRE
description:
**Role Overview**

The Lead Database SRE is responsible for the reliability, scalability, security, and automation of enterprise database platforms supporting critical business applications. This role blends deep database engineering expertise with SRE and DevOps principles to ensure highly available, performant, and resilient database services.

The role provides both production and development support for database platforms, with strong ownership of operational excellence, automation, incident response, performance engineering, and cloud database operations. The Lead Database SRE acts as a technical authority, customer concern point, and catalyst in modernising database operations through Infrastructure-as-Code and CI/CD practices.

This position has a proven focus on Oracle and SQL databases hosted on Microsoft Azure, including the migration of on prem workloads to cloud-native and hybrid architectures.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Reliability, Operations & Support**

Ensure high availability, performance, and reliability of database platforms supporting business critical applications.

Act as a point of escalation for sophisticated database production incidents and service disruptions.

Participate in on-call rotations and shift cover, including non-standard tasks when required.

Investigate and resolve incidents using SRE practices such as root cause analysis, error budgets, and post-incident reviews.

Monitor database health, capacity, and performance, ensuring proactive issue prevention.

Database Engineering & Administration

Develop, implement, and maintain database build standards, including security, patching, backup, and HA/DR.

Perform database performance tuning, diagnostics, and optimization using tools such as AWR, ASH, ADDM, and execution plan analysis.

Define and document backup, restore, upgrade, and disaster recovery procedures.

Support database connectivity using ODBC, JDBC, and vendor-specific drivers.

Provide database build and advisory support to development and application teams.

Review database application code, collaborate on improvements, and maintain artefacts using standard source control tools.

**SRE, DevOps & Automation**

Develop and implement automation for database provisioning, configuration, and lifecycle management.

Build and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) using tools such as Terraform and Ansible.

Develop and support CI/CD pipelines for database deployments and schema changes.

Define and maintain a database observability and alerting strategy, combining automated alerts with targeted manual checks.

Promote and implement self-healing, standardisation, and automation-first approaches across database services.

Cloud & Migration

Lead solution design and implementation of Oracle and SQL databases on Microsoft Azure.

Implement and support database migrations from on premise to Azure, ensuring security, resilience, and performance.

Work closely with application, cloud, and architecture teams to build scalable and secure database environments.

Ensure alignment with enterprise database standards and cloud security controls.

Security & Compliance

Partner with IT Security teams to maintain and implement database security policies.

Apply industry-standard security and compliance controls for database access, encryption, auditing, and identity management.

Evaluate applications and database usage to ensure policy alignment.

**Required Technical Skills & Experience**

Core SRE / DevOps Skills

Demonstrable experience with SRE and DevOps practices for stateful systems.

Automation and scripting using Python, Bash/KornShell, PowerShell.

Experience with Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD tooling (Jenkins, GitHub/GitLab, Bitbucket, Rundeck).

Familiarity with secrets management (HashiCorp Vault).

Exposure to containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm).

Database Technologies

Extensive hands-on experience with:

Oracle Databases (11g, 12c, 19c, up to 23ai)

RAC, Grid Infrastructure, ASM/ACFS, Data Guard

Exadata, RMAN, OEM

PL/SQL, APEX

Experience with SQL Server (2008–2022) and/or PostgreSQL.

Solid understanding of HA/DR architectures and replication technologies.

Cloud & Platforms

Good experience with Microsoft Azure database platforms.

Exposure to AWS (RDS) and hybrid cloud database deployments.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

  

The DevOps Architect — Migration Hub is the strategic owner of the CI/CD, environment management and release governance framework that powers all migration wave delivery across the Hub. Sitting at the intersection of platform engineering and delivery operations, this role designs and governs the DevOps infrastructure that enables concurrent migration teams — across Marketing Cloud Next, Agentforce Revenue Management, ITSM and Tableau Next tracks — to deploy, test, validate and release Salesforce configuration, code and data changes at Hub velocity. Unlike the hands-on DevOps Engineer (who operates day-to-day pipelines within a single track), the DevOps Architect operates at the Hub level — defining branching strategy, environment topology, pipeline standards, test automation frameworks, deployment governance and cross-wave dependency management that apply consistently to every track team. This role is accountable for ensuring the Hub never becomes a bottleneck — that release pipelines are fast, reliable, auditable and capable of supporting multiple concurrent go-lives within the same programme window. The DevOps Architect is also responsible for the platform development tooling contribution model — governing how Apex, LWC, Flow and integration code built by track teams is developed, reviewed, tested and promoted through Hub environments to production.

  
  

**RESPONSIBILITIES:** **S**

  

* **CI/CD Pipeline Architecture — Hub Standard** : Design, build and own the Hub-wide CI/CD pipeline framework using Salesforce DX, GitHub Actions and Gearset/Copado — defining the standard pipeline stages (develop validate test UAT staging production) that apply to every migration track, wave and release.
* **Environment Topology Design** : Design and manage the Hub environment topology — defining the number, purpose and refresh cadence of Developer, CI, SIT, UAT, Staging and Production environments across all active migration waves, balancing environment costs with delivery velocity requirements.
* **Branching Strategy & Version Control Governance** : Define and enforce the Hub-wide Git branching strategy — including branch naming conventions, merge policies, pull request standards, conflict resolution protocols and release tagging — ensuring all Salesforce DX source code, metadata and configuration is correctly version-controlled.
* **Scratch Org Strategy** : Design the Hub's Salesforce DX scratch org usage model — defining scratch org definitions, feature flags, shape parameters and lifecycle policies that enable track teams to develop and test in isolated, reproducible environments at scale.
* **Deployment Governance & Release Management** : Own the release management process for all migration wave deployments — defining change freeze windows, deployment sequencing, dependency maps, rollback procedures, approval gates and production deployment runbooks used across all concurrent waves.
* **Test Automation Framework** : Design and implement the Hub-wide automated test suite — including Apex test class standards, code coverage requirements, UI automation (LWC Jest, Selenium), data validation scripts and post-deployment smoke tests — integrated into every CI/CD pipeline stage.
* **Static Code Analysis & Quality Gates** : Implement and maintain static code analysis tooling (PMD, Salesforce Code Analyser, ESLint) as mandatory quality gates within the Hub pipeline — enforcing Apex best practices, Governor Limit awareness, LWC standards and security vulnerability detection before any code progresses to UAT.
* **Multi-Org & Multi-Track Pipeline Management** : Manage the complexity of concurrent multi-org pipelines across 4–5 active migration tracks — designing dependency management, cross-track metadata conflict resolution and coordinated deployment sequencing for shared Salesforce org components.
* **Data Migration Pipeline Integration** : Integrate data migration pipeline execution (ETL job scheduling, bulk load sequencing, reconciliation validation) into the Hub CI/CD framework — ensuring data migration jobs are tracked, versioned, automated and auditable alongside metadata deployments.
* **Secrets & Credential Management** : Design and enforce secure secrets management for all Hub environments — including connected app credentials, API keys, org authentication certificates, ETL connection credentials and third-party integration tokens using vault-based or CI/CD-native secrets management.
* **Monitoring & Observability** : Design the Hub's deployment monitoring and observability framework — including pipeline run dashboards, deployment success/failure metrics, apex test trend monitoring, environment health checks and post-deployment alert routing for track teams and programme leadership.

Join Recruiterflow and own the infrastructure that powers recruitment for thousands of agencies worldwide!

Within the Hybrid AI Multi-Environment Runtime, this role owns how AI services and agents are built and deployed, how models execute, how requests are routed to them, how AI assets are catalogued and governed, how consumption is measured and bounded, and how the entire platform is observed across cloud, on-prem, edge, and air-gapped environments.

  

This role owns the delivery and runtime surface, including the CI/CD/CV pipelines that ship AI workloads, secure model execution, semantic routing, and model/prompt selection, together with the governance, discovery, cost, and telemetry systems that keep AI workloads shippable, economical, discoverable, and transparent.

This role is ideal for an engineer who is equally comfortable building automated delivery pipelines, operating high-performance inference (GPUs, model servers, sandboxed execution), and building deep observability and cost visibility; who understands that in regulated contexts every AI workload must be delivered repeatedly and every AI request must be economically bounded, attributable, and traceable end-to-end.

  

**Responsibilities:**

* Own DevOps and delivery for AI workloads: build and operate the CI/CD/CV pipelines that ship AI services, agents, and runtime components, including automated build, test, continuous verification, release, and rollback, so AI workloads are delivered repeatedly and safely into every environment.
* Own governance and discovery for AI assets, including service catalog/registry (Artifactory/Nexus, Harbor), experiment tracking and model metadata (MLflow), upstream registries/mirrors (HuggingFace/NGC), CVE/SBOM scanning (Trivy), lineage contracts (OpenLineage), and license management.
* Own resource and cost management, including quotas and rate limits, cost attribution and utilization (Apptio/OpenCost/Kubecost), so AI execution stays economically bounded and controllable per tenant and engagement.
* Own the full observability stack, including metrics (Prometheus/Mimir), logs (Loki), traces (Tempo/Jaeger), dashboards (Grafana), LLM debugging and evaluation (LangSmith/Langfuse), and SLA/alert notifications.
* Own the OpenTelemetry collection layer, including multi-tenant receiver, exporters and queues (Kafka sink), DCGM exporter for GPU telemetry, processor batching, and dynamic filtering, so every signal is captured and routed reliably.
* Automate GitOps-based delivery and continuous verification; embedding quality, integrity, and cost gates into pipelines so releases are policy-compliant by default rather than by manual review.
* Close the loop between delivery and observability by using telemetry, evaluation, and cost signals to drive deployment decisions, progressive rollout, and automated rollback of AI workloads.
* Ensure cost and telemetry are identity-stamped and per-tenant, so consumption and behavior are attributable end-to-end, keeping FinOps and observability tied to the workloads that generate the load.

  

**Requirements:**

* Strong DevOps expertise: CI/CD/CV pipeline design, GitOps, continuous verification, and progressive/automated release and rollback for production workloads.
* Deep expertise operating model-serving and inference systems (Ray, vLLM/Triton/NIM) on GPUs at production scale.
* Deep observability skills: metrics, logs, traces, and OpenTelemetry.
* FinOps mindset: able to attribute, bound, and optimize AI consumption cost per tenant and workload.
* Familiarity with model/artifact governance, registries, CVE scanning, and license/lineage tracking.
* Comfortable operating across cloud, on-prem, edge, and air-gapped environments with consistent runtime and telemetry semantics.

**About the job**
-----------------

*Hope is not a strategy. Engineering solutions to design, build, and maintain efficient large-scale systems is a true strategy, and a good one.*  
  
Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) is an engineering discipline that combines software and systems engineering to build and run large-scale, massively distributed, fault-tolerant systems. SRE ensures that Google's services—both our internally critical and our externally-visible systems—have reliability and uptime appropriate to users' needs and a fast rate of improvement while keeping an ever-watchful eye on capacity and performance.  
  
SRE is also a mindset and a set of engineering approaches to running better production systems—we build our own creative engineering solutions to operations problems. Much of our software development focuses on optimizing existing systems, building infrastructure and eliminating work through automation. As SREs are responsible for the big picture of how our systems relate to each other, we use a breadth of tools and approaches to solve a broad spectrum of problems. Practices such as limiting time spent on operational work, blameless postmortems and proactive identification of potential outages factor into iterative improvement that is key to both product quality and interesting and dynamic day-to-day work.  
  
SRE's culture of diversity, intellectual curiosity, problem solving and openness is key to its success. Our organization brings together people with a wide variety of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We encourage them to collaborate, think big and take risks in a blame-free environment. We promote self-direction to work on meaningful projects, while we also strive to create an environment that provides the support and mentorship needed to learn and grow.

  
To learn more:  

* Check out *Site Reliability Engineering*, written by Google SREs.
  
* Watch a recorded Hangout on Air to meet some of our SREs.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. * Lead major reliability and modernization initiatives, including container platform migrations (e.g., ECS to EKS/GKE) and microservice enablement across multi\-cloud environments.

* Participate in the on\-call rotation, using incidents as learning opportunities to enhance systems and processes.

* Strong hands\-on experience architecting and operating cloud\-native distributed systems (AWS and GCP).
* Deep expertise with Kubernetes (EKS and GKE) — design, provisioning, scaling, and advanced troubleshooting in production.
* Proven experience leading ECS to EKS/GKE migrations and driving microservice enablement initiatives at scale.
* Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform (multi\-provider), Ansible, or CloudFormation.
* Solid coding and scripting ability in Python, Go, or Shell, with a focus on automation, tooling, and operational excellence.

* Hands\-on experience with observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Loki, OpenTelemetry, Google Cloud Operations) for performance and reliability insights.
* Working knowledge of container security, secrets management (HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Google Secret Manager), and compliance in production environments.
* Strong communication and problem\-solving skills, with demonstrated success leading cross\-team projects and mentoring peers.

**Experience:**


* 8\+ years in SRE, DevOps, or Infrastructure Engineering roles.
* 3–5 years of experience with Kubernetes (EKS/GKE) and related ecosystem tools (Helm, Karpenter, etc.) in production.
* 3–5 years of experience with AWS and GCP.
* 3–5 years using Terraform to manage multi\-cloud infrastructure.
* 3\+ years of coding experience in Python, Go, or similar languages.

Proven track record leading high\-impact projects, specifically migration projects (ECS* EKS/GKE) and enabling microservice architectures.
* Experience implementing SLOs/SLIs, performing root cause analyses, and improving operational resilience.
* Prior work in SaaS or high\-scale, cloud\-native environments is a strong plus.
* Strong Linux and security fundamentals.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent hands\-on experience.
